description: This Java source file defines an exception class `IdempotentCommandProcessFailedException`, which is thrown when a command with the same action, entity, and idempotency key is processed again, indicating an idempotency violation.

classes.name: IdempotentCommandProcessFailedException
classes.description: An exception indicating failure when processing an idempotent command that violates idempotency rules. It extends `AbstractIdempotentCommandException` and provides the appropriate HTTP status code if the database state is inconsistent.

methods.name: IdempotentCommandProcessFailedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the command wrapper, idempotency key, and command source; sets the status code based on the command's result.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception, defaulting to 500 (internal server error) if the status code is null.
